description: This script checks and reports the status of authentication credentials for Claude Code and OpenClaw, including their expiration status, and provides detailed output modes for different use cases.

methods.name: fetch_models_status_json
methods.description: Fetches the model status from OpenClaw in JSON format.

methods.name: calc_status_from_expires
methods.description: Calculates authentication status based on expiration timestamp.

methods.name: json_expires_for_claude_cli
methods.description: Extracts Claude credentials expiration from JSON status.

methods.name: json_expires_for_anthropic_any
methods.description: Extracts expiration for any anthropic profile from JSON status.

methods.name: json_best_anthropic_profile
methods.description: Determines the best anthropic profile based on expiration.

methods.name: json_anthropic_api_key_count
methods.description: Counts the number of API keys for the anthropic provider.

methods.name: check_claude_code_auth
methods.description: Checks the status of Claude Code credentials.

methods.name: check_openclaw_auth
methods.description: Checks the status of OpenClaw authentication.
